name: Marie Shougun no Shokushu Labo
original_name: マリー将軍の触手ラボ
source:
"Develop so formidable tentacles that the hero would run away as soon as he sees them!" 

As the chief developer, you will create a variety of new creatures.

Slime type? Tentacle type? What's on the tip of tentacles?
It is you to decide everything.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE241552.html]DLsite English[/url]]
